findings.title: Remaining NPE on concurrent delete in getSubGroupsStream overloads
findings.body: The fix null-checks modelSupplier.get() only in getSubGroupsCount(), but the three getSubGroupsStream overloads on the lines immediately above/below still do modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) without a null check. If the group is deleted concurrently, getGroupById returns null, so LazyModel supplies null and these methods still throw NullPointerException. The fix is incomplete for the stated concurrent-access bug.

findings.title: Concurrent group delete still NPEs in hierarchy population
findings.body: populateGroupHierarchyFromSubGroups loops while currGroup.getParentId() != null and does session.groups().getGroupById(realm, currGroup.getParentId()) with no null check. If the parent was deleted concurrently by the scenario this PR tests, parentModel is null and the next lines dereference it via groupEvaluator.canView(parentModel), toRepresentation(..., parentModel, ...) and populateSubGroupCount(parentModel, ...), causing NullPointerException. The PR claims to fix concurrent group access but leaves this reader path unfixed.

findings.title: Reader thread never joined, assertion races
findings.body: The new test starts a bare new Thread() that loops until deletedAll is set, but never stores the Thread reference, never joins it, and asserts on caughtExceptions immediately after deletedAll.set(true). Exceptions added by an in-flight request after the assertion are missed, failures can be flaky, and the thread can leak past the test method. The test must keep the thread handle and join it with a timeout before asserting.
